Summarize the core combat mechanics (or “N/A” if not mentioned).
synthesis_answer:
• Hybrid of top-down shooting and tower defense roguelike combat. [44920101]
• Escort-focused battles revolve around protecting the moving base car. [44920101]
• Summon-based Nest towers enable swarm strategies; Ant build is strong and accessible. [44920101]
• Engineer-Lion class massively buffs Nests (+75% attack speed, +50% HP). [44920101]
• Spider Nest offers early ranged damage and a later damage buff. [44920101]
• Turret rarity tiers escalate (C, A, S, SSS), impacting combat power. [44920101]
• Craftsman upgrades add effects (burn, partners, explosive ants) for boss burst. [44920101]
• Player death imposes 10-second respawn; tower placement disabled while dead. [44920101]
• Base car triggers AoE explosion each 1000 damage, clearing nearby enemies. [44920101]
• Combat resources: money from destructibles; energy from power stones and extraction. [44920101]
• Free placement enables flexible tower positioning and strategies. [41754681]
• "Perfect blend of randomness and tower defense." [44900490]
• Random growth systems drive high replayability and varied builds. [44900461, 44920101, 44900490]
• Lower difficulties feel relaxed and low-stress to play. [47008437, 44920101]
• Players appreciate units like Phantom Guardian and Phantom Nest. [47084298]
